Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy. Join: molecule_dictionary parent ON parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3338195'. Join molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno. Join molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno. Join compound_structures ON compound_structures.molregno = child.molregno. Join compound_records ON compound_records.molregno = child.molregno. Join docs ON docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id. Join activities ON activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id. Join assays ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id. Join target_dictionary ON target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid. Filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL395'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, activity_comment ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC.
